Start with the tutorials. Each one takes a small model from setup to a
returned result. The how-to guides then show how to do one task with your own
model.

## Tutorials

Do these in order. Each tutorial has three pages: **Prepare** writes a run
directory, **Run** runs the solver on it, and **Analyze** reads the result.
You can prepare on one computer and run the solver on another.

1. [Install SCGSim](course/installation.qmd).
2. [The SimplePad model](tutorials/simplepad-model.qmd): build the square-pad
   model that both tutorials use.
3. [Pad capacitance](tutorials/capacitance/prepare.qmd): compute the
   capacitance of the pad to ground with Palace Electrostatic.
4. [Resonance and EPR](tutorials/resonance-epr/prepare.qmd): add a junction
   inductance to the same pad and compute its resonance and energy
   participation with Palace or HFSS Eigenmode.

## How-to guides: your own model

Use these after the tutorials.

| Task | Guide |
|---|---|
| Assign your component's shapes to conductors and set up the model | [Work with your own model](course/working-model.qmd) |
| Check the geometry and Nets before preparing a run | [Inspect the source model](course/source-observations.qmd) |
| Check the mesh and solver input before running | [Inspect the prepared run](course/solver-observations.qmd) |
| Load results and read them correctly | [Read returned results](course/returned-results.qmd) |
| Run a prepared run directory locally or on a Slurm cluster | [Run a prepared model](course/execute.qmd) |

## How-to guides: by solver

| Calculation | Palace | AEDT |
|---|---|---|
| Capacitance matrix | [Palace Electrostatic](course/palace-electrostatic.qmd) | [Q3D](course/aedt-q3d.qmd) |
| Resonant modes and EPR | [Palace Eigenmode](course/palace-eigenmode.qmd) | [HFSS Eigenmode](course/aedt-eigenmode.qmd) |
| Port response (S-parameters) | | [Driven Modal](course/aedt-driven-modal.qmd), [Driven Terminal](course/aedt-driven-terminal.qmd) |
| Per-unit-length line parameters | | [Q2D cross sections](course/aedt-q2d.qmd) |
| AEDT model inputs shared by all families | | [AEDT inputs](course/aedt-inputs.qmd) |

## Advanced guides

- [Compute EPR from saved AEDT fields](course/aedt-saved-fields.qmd) without
  solving again. This still needs AEDT.
- [Change loss assumptions offline](course/offline-epr.qmd) on an existing
  EPR result. This needs no solver.

## Larger example: flip-chip Xmon

A full flip-chip Xmon qubit, adapted from the literature. It is not a
prerequisite for the guides above.

1. [Build the Xmon model](tutorial-xmon-input.qmd).
2. [Palace EPR for the Xmon](tutorial-xmon-palace.qmd).
3. [HFSS EPR for the Xmon](tutorial-xmon-aedt.qmd).
